title: Dating App Privacy Risk Calculator - Check Your Safety Score
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk on dating apps like Tinder, Bumble & Grindr. Get personalized safety recommendations to protect your data and location.
description: Assess your privacy risk across popular dating platforms and receive personalized recommendations to protect your personal data, location, and identity while dating online safely.

formula: const weights = { appType: { tinder: 15, bumble: 10, grindr: 25, hinge: 8, okcupid: 12, multiple: 20 }, locationSharing: { disabled: 0, approximate: 10, precise: 25, unknown: 15 }, photoPrivacy: { unique: 5, limited: 15, 'social-media': 25, identifiable: 35 }, personalInfo: { minimal: 5, some: 15, detailed: 25, extensive: 35 }, messagingHabits: { 'app-only': 5, 'phone-quick': 15, 'social-media': 20, 'video-calls': 0 }, meetingCaution: { high: 0, moderate: 10, basic: 20, low: 30 } }; const riskScore = Math.min(100, weights.appType[inputs.appType] + weights.locationSharing[inputs.locationSharing] + weights.photoPrivacy[inputs.photoPrivacy] + weights.personalInfo[inputs.personalInfo] + weights.messagingHabits[inputs.messagingHabits] + weights.meetingCaution[inputs.meetingCaution]); const vulnerabilities = [inputs.locationSharing === 'precise', inputs.photoPrivacy === 'identifiable', inputs.personalInfo === 'extensive', inputs.messagingHabits === 'phone-quick', inputs.meetingCaution === 'low'].filter(Boolean).length; const riskLevel = riskScore <= 30 ? 'Low Risk': riskScore <= 60 ? 'Moderate Risk': riskScore <= 80 ? 'High Risk': 'Critical Risk'; return { riskScore, riskLevel, vulnerabilities };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your dating app privacy risk based on six key factors: app choice (some apps have weaker privacy), location sharing settings, photo traceability, personal information exposure, communication habits, and meeting safety practices. Each factor is weighted according to real privacy vulnerabilities reported by security researchers.
tips: Use a privacy-focused browser when accessing dating apps on shared devices to prevent data tracking
Create unique photos for dating apps that can't be reverse-searched on Google Images
Hide your precise location and use approximate distance settings instead
Keep conversations in-app until you've met and verified the person's identity
Use a separate phone number or Google Voice for initial dating communications
